en: On the other hand having united all the Brāhmaṇas the great king began to celebrate the sacrifice extending over five thousand years near his city by the side of the Himālaya.

sa: अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा यमुनातीरशोभिता। शोभिता गृहमुख्यैश्च चत्वरापणवीथिकैः। चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता नानावाणिज्यशोभिता॥
en: That city on the banks of Yamună appeared beautiful like the half moon and was filled with yards, shops, streets beautiful houses, men of four orders and various articles of trade.

sa: वीरांस्तुसहितान् मेने प्राप्तराज्यान् स्वधर्मतः। बुद्धिवीर्यबलोत्साहैर्युक्तान् देवानिव द्विजः॥
en: That Brahmana, seeing those heroes endued with intelligence, strength and perseverance like the celestials, considered that they were already restored to their wealth and sovereignty by virtue of their own accomplishments.

sa: नरस्ततो वरकनकाग्रभूषणैमहेषुभिर्गगनपथं समावृणोत्। विदारयन्गिरिशिखराणि पत्रिभिः महाभयेऽसुरगणविग्रहे तदा॥
en: Then the divine Nara, appearing in the fearful battle of the Asuras and Ganas and reducing to dust those mountains by means of his gold-headed arrows, covered the heavens with dust.

sa: साध्विमं लब्धवाँल्लाभं योऽहं दिव्यास्त्रधारिणम्। गान्धर्व्या माययेच्छामि संयोजयितुमर्जुनम्॥
en: It is a great fortune to me that I have obtained a man who wields celestials weapons. I am desirous to impart to Arjuna the power of illusions of the Gandharvas.

sa: पिबन्तीर्ललमानाश्च दिव्याभरणभूषिताः। उपविष्टां च ददृशे देवयानी शुचिस्मिताम्॥
en: They were all decked with beautiful omaments and they were full of voluptuous languor on account of the honey they drank. Devayani of sweet smiles, was reclining at her same case.

sa: अध्रुवो हि कथं लोकः स्मृतो धर्मः कथं ध्रुवः। यत्र कालो ध्रुवस्तात तत्र धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: The regions of happiness which represent the results or rewards of virtue are not eternal, for they are destined to come to an end. Virtue, however, is eternal When the cause is eternal, why is the effect not so? The answer to this is as follows. Only that virtue is eternal which is not prompted by the desire of fruit or reward.

sa: चतुष्पथश्मशानानि शैलाश्चान्यान् वनस्पतीन्। कार्णायसमलंकारं परिगृह्य च नित्यशः॥
en: Having recourse to such places where four roads meet, or crematoria, or hills and mountains, or forests and trees, they build their houses. The ornaments they wear are made of iron.

sa: आषाढमेकभक्तेन स्थित्वा मासमतन्द्रितः। बहुधान्यो बहुधनो बहुपुत्रश्च जायते॥
en: He who passes the month of Ashada, taking himself one meal a day and with senses steadily concentrated upon his duties, becomes possessed of much corn, great riches and large progeny.

sa: तैस्तच्छरीरमुत्सृष्टं धर्म एकोऽनुगच्छति॥ तस्माद् सेवितव्यः सदा नृभिः।
en: Only virtue follows the body that is thus left by them all. It is therefore, plain, that virtue is the only friend and that virtues only should be sought by all.

sa: चन्द्रमण्डलशुभ्राणि किङ्किणीजालवन्ति च। अनेकशतभौमानि सान्त लवनानि च।॥
en: Bright as the lunar disc, they are ornamented with rows of tinkling bells, Hundreds among them are many storied. Within them are charming groves and gardens and transparent pools of water.

sa: याजकास्तु ततस्तस्य तानन्गीन्निर्जने वने। समुत्सृज्य यथाकामं जग्मुर्भरतसत्तम॥
en: Then the Yajaka Brahmanas he had with him cast off those fires in a solitary part of the forest and went away as they liked, O foremost one of Bharata's race.

sa: वृत्तिग्लाने सीदति चातिमात्रं कृष्यर्थे वा होम्यहेतोः प्रसूतेः। गुर्वर्थं वा बालसंवृद्धये वा धेनुं दद्याद् देशकालेऽविशिष्टे॥
en: To a Brahmana who has no means of livelihood to him while he is want of food for purposes of agriculture, for a child born on account of Homa, for the purposes of his preceptor, for the sustenance of a child born should a cow be given. Indeed, the gift should be made at a proper time and in a proper place.

sa: अभिपूजितलाभाद्धि विजुगुप्सेत भिक्षुकः। भुक्तान्यन्नानि तिक्तानि कषायकटुकानि च॥
en: The mendicant should conceal himself for avoiding gifts with honour. While eating, he should not eat the resident of another's dish, nor such food as is bitter, or astringent, or pungent.

sa: हूयमाने तथा वह्नौ होने गुणसमन्विते। देवेष्वाहूयमानेषु स्थितेषु परमर्षिषु॥ सुप्रतीतैस्तथा विप्रैः स्वागमैः सुस्वरैर्नृप। अश्रान्तैश्चापि लघुभिरध्वर्युवृषभैस्तथा॥
en: The pourer of libations, possessed of every qualification, becaine engaged in pouring libations of clarified butter. The great Rishis were seated around. The celestials were summoned by one by contented Brahmanas of great learning uttering scriptural Mantras in sweet voices. Those foremost of Adhvaryyus, not fatigued with what they did, recited the Mantras of the Yajurveda in soft account. on one one

sa: अम्भसां वरुणो राजा मरुतामिन्द्र उच्यते॥ अर्कोऽधिपतिरुष्णानां ज्योतिषामिन्दुरुच्यते।
en: Varuna is the king of the waters. Indra is said to be the king of the Maruts. Arka is the king of all hot bodies, and Indra of all luminous bodies.

sa: तेषामुत्कर्षमुद्रेकं वक्ष्याम्यहमत: परम्। यथा ते सुकृताँल्लोकाँल्लभन्ते पुण्यकर्मिणः॥
en: I shall, after this, declare what the means are of their improvement and ascent; indeed, by what means they succeed in acquiring the regions which exist for men of pious deeds.

sa: शब्दस्यादिस्तथाऽऽकाशमेष भूतकृतो गुणः। अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भूतानामादिमुत्तमम्॥
en: Likewise of sound the source is space (or Ether). These are the qualities of elements. I shall, after this, describe that which is the first and the highest of all entities.

sa: तं देशं समुपाजग्मुर्जालहस्ता महाद्युते। निषादा बहवस्तत्र मत्स्योद्धरणनिश्चयाः॥
en: With nets in their hands, O you of great effuigence, those men came where the Rishi was. They were many in number and all of them were bent upon catching fish.

sa: प्रभुर्भवसि तस्मात्त्वं समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि। ददानि मेदिनीभागं भवद्भ्योऽहं सुरर्षभाः॥
en: You are the Lord of all the universe consisting of its mobile and immobile objects. Therefore, you should grant us a piece of earth for the sacrifice we wish to make.

sa: याचमानमभीमानादनासक्तमकिंचनम्। यो नार्चति यथाशक्ति स नृशंसो युधिष्ठिर॥
en: That man, O Yudhishthira, is a cruel wight, who, through vanity, does not, to the extent of his means, attend to the wishes of the poor and helpless who solicit assistance.

sa: अथ शिष्यसहस्राणि समनुज्ञातवानृषिः। उत्तङ्क परया प्रीत्या नाभ्यनुज्ञातुमैच्छता
en: One after another, thousands of disciples received the preceptors' permission to return home. On account, however, of his great affection for Utanka, Gautama could not permit him to leave his hermitage.

sa: देवानभ्यर्चयच्चापि विधिवत् स सुरेश्वरः। सर्वानेव यथान्यायं यथापूर्वमरिन्दम॥
en: And, O chastiser of foes, Nahusha, although he had become the king's of the deities, yet adored all the deities, as he used to do formerly, with due rites and ceremonies.

sa: ततो गान्धारराजस्य मन्त्रिवृद्धपुरःसरा! जननी निर्ययौ भीता पुरस्कृत्यार्धमुत्तमम्॥
en: Then the mother of the king of the Gandharas, filled with fear, and with all the aged ministers of state, came out of her city, taking an excellent Arghya for Arjuna.

sa: ततस्तं दर्भविन्यासं भित्त्वा सुरुचिरागदः। प्रलम्बाभरणो बाहुरुदतिष्ठद् विशाम्पते॥
en: I then saw, O king, that a beautiful arm, adorned with armlets and other ornaments, rose a up, piercing the ground, through the blades of Kusha grass which I had spread.
